title: Eurostat sdg_11_52: premature deaths due to PM2.5 exposure, Italy (annual)
summary: Eurostat SDG indicator table sdg_11_52 (ESTAT), served as JSON-stat 2.0 through the Eurostat dissemination API, filtered to geo=IT. It holds annual counts (unit NR) and rates (unit RT) of premature deaths attributed to fine particulate matter (PM2.5), at national level only. The populated series runs from 2005 to 2023 with 18 time periods, and 36 cells with no missing values. It is national context for UC1 (N6) and does not cover hourly, district or city-level needs.

documentation_excerpts: Dataset label (JSON-stat): "Premature deaths due to exposure to fine particulate matter (PM2.5)", source "ESTAT", updated "2025-12-09T11:00:00+0100".
quality_notes: Window fit: the data starts in 2005 and ends in 2023. Only 2005 falls inside the prototype window (2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04), and it is an annual value. The production window (2024-2025) is outside the data range, so the source cannot be mapped to production.
Gap: the time dimension lists 2005, 2007, 2008 ... 2023. Year 2006 is absent, so the series has 18 periods, not 19.
Coverage: national only and annual only. It does not meet N1-N4 (hourly pollutants, hourly traffic, hourly weather, daily clinic counts). It can only serve N6.
Freshness: the metadata update stamp is 2025-12-09. No refresh cadence is stated in the source.
Licence: unknown. Do not treat as open for production use until Legal reviews it.
